suppress.notes: CCD-8336: Spring Framework 6.2.19 CVEs cannot be resolved without moving to Spring Framework 7 / Spring Boot 4. Spring Boot 4 is explicitly out of scope, and forcing Spring Framework 7 under Spring Boot 3.5.16 breaks Boot 3 Web MVC auto-configuration due Spring 7 API removals.

CCD-8336: Handlebars 4.3.1 is pulled transitively by WireMock. Newer Handlebars versions are not available to the Jenkins build repositories used by this service, so this finding is suppressed against the embedded Commons Lang metadata path only.
CCD-8336: Jackson is kept on the Spring Boot 3.5.16 managed version because newer Jackson versions are not available to the Jenkins build repositories used by this service.
